descriptions.notStarted: Start a conversation with #bEmpress #p1101000##k, who is sitting quietly next to #p1101001#.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1101000# thanked you for becoming one of her Knights and asked that you stay by her side for a long time. She then went on to say that her tactician, #b#p1101002##k, is going to help you become a competent Knight.
descriptions.completed: #p1101002# said you weren't strong enough to fight for Maple World, let alone appoint you as a Knight-in-Training. He said you must undergo a training course that has been prepared for you. Let's go see #p1102000#, the training instructor.
